sn_aia_tool.description: Generates action recommendations for skipped items including resolving prerequisites, clearing conflicts, scheduling maintenance windows, and testing requirements. Provides estimated effort and priority for each recommendation.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"skipped_items","description":"JSON string of still-relevant skipped items with skip reasons and current state","mandatory":true}]
sn_aia_tool.name: Suggest Actions
